```{=html}
<style>
.w134-dd { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w134-dd .w134-rows { margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w134-dd .w134-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.w134-dd .w134-row.w134-right { border-color: #2e7d32; border-width: 2px; }
.w134-dd .w134-row.w134-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; border-width: 2px; }
.w134-dd .w134-text { flex: 1; }
.w134-dd .w134-tf { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.w134-dd .w134-tf button {
  padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.w134-dd .w134-tf button.w134-sel { background: #d81e2e; border-color: #d81e2e; color: #fff; }
.w134-dd .w134-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w134-dd .w134-controls button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w134-dd .w134-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w134-dd .w134-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w134-dd .w134-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w134-dd .w134-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
</style>
<div class="w134-dd iw" id="w134-dd">
  <div class="w134-rows"></div>
  <div class="w134-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w134-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w134-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w134-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w134-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w134-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w134-dd');
  const rowsBox = root.querySelector('.w134-rows');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w134-msg');
  const STATEMENTS = [
    { answer: true,  text: 'A cloud-native application is a large distributed system, and such systems are complex by nature, however carefully they are built.' },
    { answer: true,  text: 'Govern, Identify, Protect and Detect run continuously, while Respond and Recover stand ready for the incident.' },
    { answer: true,  text: 'Security is a method rather than a product: name the threat, judge the risk, choose the control that fits, state why.' },
    { answer: false, text: 'The defensible system is built as a single mechanism rather than a set of independent layers.' },
    { answer: false, text: 'In a distributed system, network delays have only the effects the designers planned for.' },
    { answer: false, text: 'Once every layer is in place, the question whether the system is secure has a permanent yes as its answer.' }
  ];
  const rows = [];

  function clearMarks() {
    rows.forEach(r => r.el.classList.remove('w134-right', 'w134-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w134-msg iw-msg';
  }
  STATEMENTS.forEach(st => {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'w134-row';
    const span = document.createElement('span');
    span.className = 'w134-text';
    span.textContent = st.text;
    const tf = document.createElement('span');
    tf.className = 'w134-tf';
    const state = { el: row, answer: st.answer, sel: null, btns: {} };
    [['True', true], ['False', false]].forEach(([label, val]) => {
      const b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button';
      b.textContent = label;
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        state.sel = (state.sel === val) ? null : val;
        state.btns[true].classList.toggle('w134-sel', state.sel === true);
        state.btns[false].classList.toggle('w134-sel', state.sel === false);
        clearMarks();
      });
      state.btns[val] = b;
      tf.appendChild(b);
    });
    row.appendChild(span); row.appendChild(tf);
    rowsBox.appendChild(row);
    rows.push(state);
  });

  root.querySelector('.w134-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, wrong = 0, open = 0;
    rows.forEach(r => {
      r.el.classList.remove('w134-right', 'w134-wrong');
      if (r.sel === null) { open++; return; }
      if (r.sel === r.answer) { r.el.classList.add('w134-right'); right++; }
      else { r.el.classList.add('w134-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    if (right === rows.length) {
      msg.textContent = '✓ All correct — the layers are independent, the complexity is real, and the argument is never finished.';
      msg.className = 'w134-msg iw-msg ok';
    } else if (open > 0 && wrong === 0) {
      msg.textContent = 'Keep going — ' + open + ' statement(s) still unanswered.';
      msg.className = 'w134-msg iw-msg';
    } else {
      msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — the red statements are marked wrongly. Re-read the closing argument.';
      msg.className = 'w134-msg iw-msg bad';
    }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w134-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    rows.forEach(r => {
      r.sel = r.answer;
      r.btns[true].classList.toggle('w134-sel', r.answer === true);
      r.btns[false].classList.toggle('w134-sel', r.answer === false);
      r.el.classList.remove('w134-wrong');
      r.el.classList.add('w134-right');
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w134-msg iw-msg ok';
  });
  root.querySelector('.w134-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    rows.forEach(r => {
      r.sel = null;
      r.btns[true].classList.remove('w134-sel');
      r.btns[false].classList.remove('w134-sel');
    });
    clearMarks();
  });
})();
</script>
```
